data.title: Getting Started with Umbraco Compose
data.summary: Learn how to set up and use Umbraco Compose for your headless CMS needs.
data.content: Umbraco Compose is a powerful platform for composing content from multiple sources. In this article, we'll explore the key concepts and how to get started.

data.title: Advanced GraphQL Queries in Umbraco Compose

data.content: GraphQL provides powerful query capabilities. Learn how to filter by custom fields, sort results, and implement cursor-based pagination.

data.title: Understanding Content Schemas

data.content: Content schemas define the structure of your content. Learn how to create flexible, reusable schemas using JSON Schema.
data.author: John Doe
